description: This Java source file defines the StatsRoute class, which constructs HTTP routes for providing statistics in a gateway service using Akka HTTP. It includes route definitions for endpoints like /stats, /stats/things, /stats/search, and /stats/things/details, and handles requests related to retrieving statistics and counts of things with integration points for DevOps commands.

classes.name: StatsRoute
classes.description: Defines HTTP routes for statistics endpoints, handling requests for retrieving general stats, detailed stats, and counts related to 'things', with support for DevOps configurations and authentication.

methods.name: buildStatsRoute
methods.description: Constructs the full /stats route, attaching sub-routes for things and search statistics.

methods.name: buildSubRoutes
methods.description: Builds sub-route definitions for /things and /search under /stats.

methods.name: buildDetailsRoute
methods.description: Builds the /things/details route with DevOps basic authentication and parameters for entity and namespace.

methods.name: handleDevOpsPerRequest
methods.description: Executes a DevOps command within an HTTP request context, managing asynchronous response.

methods.name: handleSudoCountThingsPerRequest
methods.description: Handles the request to count all 'things' and respond with a JSON containing the count.

methods.name: buildDevOpsDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates DittoHeaders with the correlation ID and schema version for DevOps requests.
